challenges: Do a 20-second impression of any friend in the group.
Everyone must speak in rhymes until the next round ends.
Take a selfie with the funniest face possible.
Hold a plank for 30 seconds while telling a joke.
Make a silly 10-second advertisement for the nearest object.
Call a friend and say only 'Beep boop' for 10 seconds.
Say a tongue twister three times fast.
Balance a spoon on your nose for 15 seconds.
Pretend to be a news reporter and report on the room.
Act out an animal; the group must guess it.
Swap one accessory with another player for the rest of the game.
punishments: Do 5 dramatic sighs between every sentence for 2 minutes.
Buy the next round of chai or snacks.
Be the group's personal photographer for the next hour.
Speak only in questions for 5 minutes.
Sing a happy birthday song to the nearest wall.
Give everyone a compliment, with a bow.
Wear your socks on your hands until the next round.
Make a dramatic apology speech to a cushion.
Let the group pick your profile picture for a day (harmless!).
Do the robot dance for 30 seconds.
Say 'I am the king/queen of failing' loudly three times.
Walk like a penguin to the kitchen and back.
